# Suggested work email migration (2026-01-31 15:55Z)

_**User**_

Create a new migration that allows the user to only update the suggested_work_email. This update will automatically update last_otp_sent_at. Do not allow the user to edit anything in user object. Just keep the handle_new_auth_user functional

        "contents": "begin\n  v_encrypted_password := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;&gt;'encrypted_password';\n  \n  if v_encrypted_password is not null then\n    raise exception 'Password-based signups are not allowed. Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\n  end if;\n  \n  v_provider := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  v_app_metadata := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata';\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  end if;\n  \n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities' is not null then\n    for v_identity in \n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities')\n    loop\n      if v_identity-&gt;&gt;'provider' = 'google' then\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\n        exit;\n      end if;\n    end loop;\n  end if;\n  \n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\n    return event;\n  end if;\n  \n  raise exception 'Only Google OAuth signups are allowed. Please use Google to sign in.';\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) is 'Hook function that restricts signups to Google OAuth only. Blocks password-based and OTP signups.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create triggers for updated_at on all tables\ncreate trigger users_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger teams_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.teams\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger profiles_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.profiles\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to populate public.users\ndrop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\nafter insert on auth.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_new_auth_user();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table for email domain validation\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;",

        "contents": "create table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership.         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n      const redirectTo = next || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking. Separate from auth.users but linked via auth_user_id for authentication.';\n\n-- Create teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.teams is 'Team information for organizing users into groups.';\n\n-- Create profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useState, useEffect } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { GoogleLoginButton } from \"@/components/google-login-button\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\n\n/**\n * Test page for verifying auth restrictions\n * Tests:\n * - Google OAuth signup (should work)\n * - Email/password signup (should be blocked)\n * - OTP email signup (should be blocked)\n * - Email identity addition (should validate CZU domain)\n */\nexport default function AuthTestPage() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState&lt;{\n    emailPassword?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailOTP?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailIdentity?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n  }&gt;({});\n\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    checkUser();\n    supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(() =&gt; {\n      checkUser();\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  const checkUser = async () =&gt; {\n    const {\n      data: { user: currentUser },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    setUser(currentUser);\n    setLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  const testEmailPasswordSignup = async (e: React.FormEvent&lt;HTMLFormElement&gt;)\n;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

        },
        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "### Next.js (All Business Logic)",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation",
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement",
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "│                         Next.js                                  │",
            "lineNumber": 393
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.21614070236682892

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: otpCode.trim(),\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n  \n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  if (\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/login\") &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\")\n  ) {\n    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/config.toml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 261
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 321
          }

        "contents": "template = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another sms otp.\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Use pre-defined map of phone number to OTP for testing.\n# [auth.sms.test_otp]\n# 4152127777 = \"123456\"\n\n# Configure logged in session timeouts.\n# [auth.sessions]\n# Force log out after the specified duration.\n# timebox = \"24h\"\n# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Migration created. Summary:

## Migration Summary

**File:** `supabase/migrations/20260131120000_restrict_user_updates.sql`

### Features:

1. **Restricted updates**: Users can only update `suggested_work_email`. All other fields (`id`, `auth_user_id`, `google_email`, `google_profile_picture`, `google_full_name`, `created_at`) are reset to their original values.

2. **Automatic `last_otp_sent_at` update**: When `suggested_work_email` changes, `last_otp_sent_at` is set to `now()`. If `suggested_work_email` doesn't change, `last_otp_sent_at` remains unchanged.

3. **Preserves `handle_new_auth_user`**: The `handle_new_auth_user` function remains functional because it's an INSERT trigger, while this migration only affects UPDATE operations.

4. **RLS policy update**: Replaced the permissive "Users can update their own user record" policy with a more restrictive one that still allows users to update their own records, but the trigger enforces the field restriction.

### How it works:

- The `handle_user_update_restriction()` trigger function runs BEFORE UPDATE
- It resets all fields except `suggested_work_email` to their original values
- It automatically sets `last_otp_sent_at` when `suggested_work_email` changes
- The `updated_at` field is still handled by the existing `handle_updated_at()` trigger

The migration is ready to apply. It ensures users can only modify `suggested_work_email`, and `last_otp_sent_at` is automatically updated when that field changes.

      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"restrict_user_updates\",\"query\":\"-- ============================================================================\\n-- FUNCTIONS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger function to restrict updates to suggested_work_email only\\n-- Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes\\n-- Prevents users from modifying any other fields in the users table\\ncreate or replace function public.handle_user_update_restriction()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public, auth\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  -- Allow only suggested_work_email to be changed\\n  -- Reset all other fields to their original values to prevent modification\\n  new.id := old.id;\\n  new.auth_user_id := old.auth_user_id;\\n  new.google_email := old.google_email;\\n  new.google_profile_picture := old.google_profile_picture;\\n  new.google_full_name := old.google_full_name;\\n  new.created_at := old.created_at;\\n  \\n  -- Automatically update last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes\\n  if old.suggested_work_email is distinct from new.suggested_work_email then\\n    new.last_otp_sent_at := now();\\n  else\\n    -- Keep existing last_otp_sent_at if suggested_work_email hasn't changed\\n    new.last_otp_sent_at := old.last_otp_sent_at;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- updated_at is handled by the existing handle_updated_at() trigger\\n  -- so we don't need to set it here\\n  \\n  return new;\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\ncomment on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() is 'Trigger function that restricts user updates to suggested_work_email only. Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes. Prevents modification of all other fields including google_email, google_profile_picture, google_full_name, auth_user_id, id, and created_at.';\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- TRIGGERS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Create trigger to enforce update restrictions on users table\\n-- This trigger runs BEFORE the update to prevent field modifications\\ndrop trigger if exists users_update_restriction_trigger on public.users;\\n\\ncreate trigger users_update_restriction_trigger\\nbefore update on public.users\\nfor each row\\nexecute function public.handle_user_update_restriction();\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- RLS POLICIES\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Drop the existing permissive update policy\\ndrop policy if exists \\\"Users can update their own user record\\\" on public.users;\\n\\n-- Create a new restrictive update policy that only allows updating suggested_work_email\\n-- The trigger function will enforce that only suggested_work_email can be changed\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update only suggested_work_email\\\" on public.users\\nfor update\\nto authenticated\\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\\n\\ncomment on policy \\\"Users can update only suggested_work_email\\\" on public.users is 'RLS policy that allows authenticated users to update only their own user record. The handle_user_update_restriction() trigger enforces that only suggested_work_email can be modified, and automatically updates last_otp_sent_at.';\\n\\n-- ============================================================================\\n-- GRANTS\\n-- ============================================================================\\n\\n-- Grant execute permissions for the new trigger function\\ngrant execute on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() to authenticated;\\ngrant execute on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() to anon;\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}
